sentences.text:
Smt. Mamta vs Rajesh Kumar Guatam on 18 April, 2023
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 1
Case :- Transfer Application (Civil) No. - 194 of 2023
Applicant :- Smt. Mamta

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- Rajesh Kumar Guatam Counsel for Applicant :- Ajai Kumar Singh Hon'ble Vikas Budhwar,J.
Heard Sri Ajay Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the applicant.

This is an application under section 24 of the Court of Civil Procedure 1908, with a prayer to transfer the proceedings in case No. 555 of 2022, (Rajesh Kumar V. Smt. Mamta) under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 from the Court of the Principal Judge, Family court, Kannauj to the Principal Judge, Family Court at Kanpur Nagar.

entities.text: Court of the Principal Judge, Family court, Kannauj
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: As per the averments contained in the application itself it is alleged that the applicant solemnized the marriage with the opposite party/husband on 20.11.2019.

However, all sorts of harassment and torture were being inflicted upon the applicant, compelled with this situation she had no option but to lodge an FIR on 21.11.2022 which was registered as Case Crime No.0227 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, I.P.C and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Rawatpur, District- Kanpur Nagar against the opposite party and the family members.

It has been further averred that proceeding under Domestic Violence Act initiated on 29.11.2022 in Case No. 5108 of 2022 (Mamta Devi V. Rajesh Kumar and others) under section 12, 18, 19, 20, 22 Domestic Violence, Police Station- Rawatpur, District- Kanpur Nagar, which is still pending before the learned Court ACJ (J.D.) 0-5 Kanpur Nagar.

entities.text: Mamta Devi V. Rajesh Kumar and others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Domestic Violence, Police Station- Rawatpur, District- Kanpur Nagar
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the applicant has further sought to argue that the opposite party just in order to pressurize the applicant to come to terms according to their wishes had filed case No. 555 of 2022 (Rajesh Kumar V. Smt. Mamta) in under Smt. Mamta vs Rajesh Kumar Guatam on 18 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/86270657/
1 Section 9 of Hindu Marriage Act, before the court of Principal Judge, Family Court Kannauj on 15.11.2022.

entities.text: Smt. Mamta vs Rajesh Kumar Guatam
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In paragraph 8 and 9 of the affidavit in support of the transfer application it has been further averred that the applicant is living with her mother who is aged about 67 years, she is blessed with on female child and is living with one unmarried sister.
Thus, it is difficult for her to travel from Kanpur to Kannauj as she has no independent income or a vehicle.
Learned Counsel for the applicant further invited the attention towards paragraph no. 11 and 12 so as to contend that the opposite party are wealthy people and there is threat perception also.
Thus, prayer in the present application is for a direction for transfer of the said case from Kannauj to Kanpur Nagar.
This Court on 03.03.2023, while entertaining the present application had issued notices to the opposite party and also granted interim protection.
Office report dated 01.04.2023 reveals that the applicant has taken steps through ordinary process and by registered post AD.
There is office report dated 17.04.2023, which reveals that the sole respondent refused to accept notices.
Thus the service upon opposite party is deemed sufficient.
As discussed above, the applicant claims to be the wife who has initiated the proceedings not only under Domestic Violence Act and under the provisions of the I.P.C. read with Dowry Prohibition Act.

She has made specific statements in various paragraphs of the affidavit in support of the fact that the applicant is unable to present herself during the proceedings at the court of Principal Judge,
Family Court Kannauj.

Thus, in view of the above circumstances the present transfer application is allowed while transferring the proceedings in Case No. 555 of 2022 (Rajesh Kumar V. Smt. Mamta) which is stated to be pending under Section-9 of the Hindu Marriage Act from Principal Judge family Court,
Kannauj to Principal Judge Family Court, Kanpur Nagar.

entities.text: Principal Judge Family Court, Kanpur Nagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: With the aforesaid the present application stands allowed.
